title: MEDIA_DEVICE_STATE event
description: Mic-or-camera in-use edge, with the kind of call when in use. Never the app name, path, window title, or any audio/video. See ADR-0003 §7, ADR-0009, ADR-0012.

in_use.description: True when any process is using the microphone or any camera (mic OR camera).

call_type.description: Category of the app holding the microphone, from the ADR-0012 allowlist. Only when in_use is true.
